name: ART On Demand (St. Lucie County)
note: 3 partial zones, not full-city coverage: Zone 1 is SW Port St. Lucie only (not the whole city); Zone 2 is the St. Lucie West/Torino area, an unincorporated CDP west of Port St. Lucie with no separately mappable Census/place boundary in this tool, so it is not drawn as its own polygon here; Zone 3 is SW Fort Pierce plus the area around Treasure Coast International Airport (not the whole city). No published zone-boundary map or acreage; only named transfer points between zones (Port St. Lucie Intermodal, Bayshore Park & Ride, Jobs Express Terminal; White City Park and a Ralls Rd point in Fort Pierce). Source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/area-regional-transit/our-services/microtransit

name: Island Hopper
note: NassauTRANSIT's Island Hopper covers the northern half of Amelia Island (fixed loop from Fernandina Beach City Hall), with Saturday on-demand service described by the operator as 'island-wide,' extending beyond Fernandina Beach city limits to unincorporated Amelia Island (e.g. American Beach). No incorporated-place or zone-size data exists for the island itself, so Nassau County is shown as an approximate proxy — actual coverage is limited to Amelia Island, not the mainland county. Sources: nassautransit.org/island-hopper/; fernandinaobserver.org, "NassauTRANSIT re-launches the Island Hopper with Saturday Island-wide service."

name: VoRide
